name: Dress To Slay 👠
desc:
✨ Welcome To Dress To Slay, inspired by "Dress To Impress" ✨

Dress To Slay is the ultimate fashion competition on Roblox! 🌟 Each round, you'll get a new outfit theme. Use the catalog to create show-stopping outfits, earn stars, and climb the ranks from New Model to Supermodel! 👗💃 Vote on other players' looks and see who wins. Dress up, impress, and slay!

🌼 Use code "SPRING" 👍 Like for more codes 😊

🌞 NEW UPDATE 🌈
- 💇 New hair station, clothes, themes, emotes + more! ❤️
- 🐶 Pets! Walk the runway with a furry friend 🐾
- 🛒 Click "Buy Outfit" button to buy your entire look in 1 click! ✅ Saves to Roblox inventory ✅ Use in other games ✅

⚠️ All items are purchasable for Robux and will save to your Roblox avatar! 🛍️
